messages:
nina: quick heads-up: saw a correctness blip in the unified-kv handoff path during canary. reads can observe demoted prefixes for a short window (~200-400ms). not data loss but breaks streaming cursor semantics.

anne: confirmed. root cause = removed sync lease-refresh in unified path to save an RPC; opened small race where cached residency lags epoch propagation.

miguel: options: keep async (best perf), reintroduce lease-refresh on handoff (strong), or pragmatic fast-invalidate + targeted strong-reads for active cursors.

sam: propose a feature toggle kv.unified.strict_handoff (default OFF). enable strict for Dedicated/Private; Hosted stays OFF while we gather telemetry. add metric prefetch.handoff_inconsistent_reads and a canary run + chaos test (kill owner mid-handoff).

nina: sounds good. quantify perf cost (p99 delta) and add unit for lease-epoch fencing.

anne: microbench shows ~0.8ms p99 delta on handoff-heavy traces. i'll open a ticket and schedule a 72h canary with the flag ON for a small percentage.

opsbot: Ticket RDW-ENG-10123 created: "canary: strict_handoff toggle deploy + repro". Assignees: nina, anne, miguel, sam. Canary window: 72h.

sam: i'll follow up with chaos test and attach results here. thanks.
